LanguageData.MJV_ArrestRefused: {PAWN_nameDef}'s Promachos helmet will not let {PAWN_objective} be taken: Justiciar Valor!
LanguageData.MJV_PromachosArmorTip: Psychic shield: absorbs gunfire, projectiles and blasts, but not melee attacks. It recharges a few seconds after the last hit, and resets some time after it breaks.\n\nInvictus: every hit the shield absorbs stores energy for the Invictus ability.
LanguageData.MJV_InvictusNoArmor: Needs a Promachos armor's psychic shield
LanguageData.MJV_InvictusNotCharged: Not enough stored energy ({0}, needs {1}). The psychic shield stores energy from the hits it absorbs.
LanguageData.MJV_PsyOrbToggleDesc: While switched on, the energy psy-spear synthesizes psy-orbs (one every five seconds, up to three) and keeps them inside. When the wielder is drafted or fighting, the orbs come out to circle the wielder and are launched at enemies within range on their own. Each orb sears what it hits and slows it for a few seconds.\n\nOrbs ready: {0} / {1}
LanguageData.MJV_WarlockbaneTip: Warlockbane: turns aside hostile psycasts aimed at the bearer and stuns their caster with the backlash. Each deflection spends a charge; charges come back slowly.\n\nCharges: {0} / {1}
LanguageData.MJV_TomeNoBlueprints: No unfinished project needs imperial techprints
LanguageData.MJV_TomeNothingToLearn: {PAWN_nameDef} studied the imperial tome but found nothing the colony still needs.
LanguageData.MJV_TomeStudiedText: {PAWN_nameDef} has deciphered the technical appendices of an imperial auspex and recovered a blueprint for {1}.\n\nTechprints applied: {2} / {3}
LanguageData.MJV_SermonStarted: {PREACHER_nameDef} has begun a sermon of {FAITH}. Colonists who are free to will gather to listen.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryArrivedSolo: {PREACHER_nameFull}, a missionary of {FAITH}, has come from {FACTION_name} to preach the imperial faith at your colony.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryArrivedEscorted: {PREACHER_nameFull}, a missionary of {FAITH}, has come from {FACTION_name} to preach the imperial faith at your colony. For protection, {PREACHER_nameDef} travels with {COUNT} {ESCORT}.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryArrivedExplain: {PREACHER_nameDef} will stay for about {DURATION} and hold sermons. Colonists whose schedule allows recreation will gather to listen, and every sermon shakes the certainty of those who do not share the imperial faith; those whose certainty breaks will convert. {FACTION_name} will look kindly on every convert.\n\nIf you would rather your people kept their faith, keep them busy while {PREACHER_nameDef} preaches.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryLeaving: {PREACHER_nameDef} has finished {PREACHER_possessive} mission and is leaving.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryLeavingConverted: Your whole colony now follows {FAITH}. {PREACHER_nameDef} considers {PREACHER_possessive} work here done and is leaving.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionEscortLeaving: Without their missionary, the escort from {0} is going home.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionColonyConvertedText: Your whole colony now follows {FAITH}. {PREACHER_nameDef} considers {PREACHER_possessive} work here done: the imperial shuttle has been called to collect {PREACHER_objective} early.
LanguageData.MJV_CalledToServiceText: {PAWN_nameDef} has heard the call of {FAITH} and has decided to leave with {PREACHER_nameDef} to serve the Empire.\n\n{PAWN_nameDef} is walking to the imperial shuttle to board it. If you want to keep {PAWN_objective}, you can arrest {PAWN_objective} before {PAWN_pronoun} gets there.
LanguageData.MJV_CalledToServiceLeftText: {PAWN_nameDef} has left with {PREACHER_nameDef} on the imperial shuttle to serve the Empire.
